      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to enable running txindex on pruned nodes.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables txindex to operate on pruned nodes, resolving multiple longstanding issues (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). By storing block hashes instead of file offsets, it allows pruned nodes to maintain a complete transaction index without storing raw block files."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies getrawtransaction and gettxoutproof RPCs in src/rpc/, adding structured error responses and graceful handling of pruned undo data.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.62,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Updates RPC interfaces to handle lookups for pruned blocks by returning candidate block hashes in structured error data and omitting missing undo fields. This eliminates hard failures for getrawtransaction verbosity 2 and provides programmatic consumers with the exact block hashes needed to fetch missing data."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
